slot_scores.name: no_borrowing_cash_only
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether borrowing is allowed or whether investments must be funded only from cash on hand and matured proceeds. The cash-flow constraints in READY_TO_MODEL silently assume no borrowing, but this was not explicitly confirmed as a hidden fact.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No borrowing is allowed; investments must be funded only by currently available cash from initial capital and matured proceeds.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about borrowing or cash-only funding, but the READY_TO_MODEL cash-flow constraints assume no borrowing and no negative cash balances.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about borrowing/cash-only funding remained unresolved and was silently assumed.

summary: The agent clarified several useful boundary details but failed to ask about the no-borrowing/cash-only constraint, silently assuming it in the final model. This leaves a P1 hidden slot unresolved at stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
